name: Aiba Maho
source:
Class: Chrysanthemum, First Year
Club Affiliation: Social Issues Society

[url=/c97599]Shiori[/url]'s good friend and classmate, she's a kind and caring girl with a bubbly personality and a penchant for gossip. She puts others before herself and is a late bloomer when it comes to romance. As [url=/c97601]Yumi[/url]'s confidante, she sometimes visits her in the infirmary and delivers letters on her behalf.

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1252]MangaGamer[/url]]
